🤖 Talos triage · confidence: high

Talos can make mistakes. Please check important information.

Verdict
Not a defect — this is the routine monthly data-alignment upload McDonald's sends every month (same request as the February–May instalments), and it just needs the attached spreadsheet run through the usual import.

What we checked

  • Our notes for this customer already describe this exact monthly request, including the step-by-step import procedure and the standard pass/fail summary we post back on the ticket — nothing about this October submission departs from that pattern.

  • The import is done with a standalone tool on a dedicated machine; there is no code in the main application involved in it, so no product change is implied by this request.

Next

  • Run the monthly alignment import against the attached October spreadsheet following the documented procedure, then post the standard summary (counts of records updated/created for people, locations and logins) back on this ticket.

  • Before starting, confirm the attachment here is the latest one — this customer has previously followed up with a revised file after the first submission, and only the newest should be used.
